title: Appending Statements to an Evaluation
statement: For any natural number $n$, lists $ss$ and $ext$ of straight-line statements on $n$ Boolean inputs, and a Boolean input assignment $x$, there exists a list $e$ such that evaluating $ss$ followed by $ext$ gives the list obtained by appending $e$ to the evaluation of $ss$.
hypotheses_covered: $ss$ and $ext$ are lists of statements on $n$ inputs
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to the $n$ inputs
